title: Review the scorecard in this order

nodes.label: Controls / incidents
nodes.detail: Action and recovery traces; incident severity; routine and control results by case. Suspend affected capability for prohibited execution, exposure or High/Medium incidents.

nodes.label: Affordability
nodes.detail: Incurred cost, remaining commitments and cost to finish. Preserve funds for follow-up and shutdown.

nodes.label: Evidence / completion
nodes.detail: All assignments, outcome states and required observations. Explain every missing record.

nodes.label: Unit cost / sensitivity
nodes.detail: C_a / A_a and pilot/comparison ratio; recalculate after each engineer omission. Preserve failed-task costs.

nodes.label: Recovery / integrity
nodes.detail: Setup, conservative net benefit, eligible demand, demonstrated capacity and reuse; protocol deviations and version history.

textEquivalent: Review the scorecard in this order. 1. Controls / incidents: Action and recovery traces; incident severity; routine and control results by case. Suspend affected capability for prohibited execution, exposure or High/Medium incidents. 2. Affordability: Incurred cost, remaining commitments and cost to finish. Preserve funds for follow-up and shutdown. 3. Evidence / completion: All assignments, outcome states and required observations. Explain every missing record. 4. Unit cost / sensitivity: C_a / A_a and pilot/comparison ratio; recalculate after each engineer omission. Preserve failed-task costs. 5. Recovery / integrity: Setup, conservative net benefit, eligible demand, demonstrated capacity and reuse; protocol deviations and version history.
